Their density equation yields the TBA-like equation, with normalization fixed by the rod length. Both proofs hold as formal power series in the complex structure parameter, with exact dependence on $q=e^{i\hbar}$.
summary: 我们给出了量子 $A$ 周期和量子镜曲线的热力学 Bethe ansatz (TBA) 式方程之间的两个猜想关系的代数证明。二次关系由平移乘积展开式的常数项得出。对于更高阶的关系，循环量子环迹和有限矩阵行列式用非重叠杆的自由能来确定周期。他们的密度方程产生类似 TBA 的方程，归一化由杆长度固定。两个证明都以复杂结构参数中的形式幂级数形式存在，并且精确依赖于 $q=e^{i\hbar}$。

title: Fast holographic inversion of superconducting domes
abstract: A holographic superconductor whose scalar mass depends on the gauge field strength, $M(\Fsq)$, reproduces a superconducting dome for a suitable $M$, and recovering that $M$ from a given dome has so far taken days for a single training run. We propose a new way of training this model, with which an inversion takes from about ten minutes to an hour. Training needs the gradient of the condition that fixes the critical temperature, which the earlier method obtains by finite differences, repeating the bulk integrations for every training parameter. Here that condition is obtained, without any fit, from two integrations started at the horizon and at the boundary, and its derivative with respect to $M$ is an integral over the same two solutions, so the gradient needs no integration of its own. We use the speed to study the part of $M$ that a dome cannot determine, on the interval between the value $\Fsq$ takes at the horizon for the lowest doping and $\Fsq=0$, at which $M$ is the scalar mass $M(0)$ that fixes the dimension of the dual operator. We hold the scalar mass at several values, which we call pinned masses, retrain everything else at each, and find that the reconstructions agree wherever the horizons of the dome reach, including the minima of $M$, and differ only on that interval. A rule that keeps the reconstruction with the simplest closed form recovers both the scalar mass and the mass function of a test dome. On Gaussian and double-Gaussian domes and on the measured phase diagrams of YBa$_{2}$Cu$_{3}$O$_{y}$ and 2M-WS$_{2}$, however, the pinned mass it keeps rests on ties or on narrow margins, so for these targets the scalar mass is left open. The dome thus constrains $M$ where its horizons reach, and fixing the dimension of the dual operator needs a second observable.
summary:
全息超导体的标量质量取决于规范场强度 $M(\Fsq)$，可以为合适的 $M$ 重现超导圆顶，并且迄今为止，从给定圆顶恢复 $M$ 的单次训练需要数天时间。我们提出了一种训练该模型的新方法，反演需要大约十分钟到一个小时。训练需要固定临界温度的条件梯度，早期的方法通过有限差分获得，对每个训练参数重复批量积分。这里的条件是从地平线和边界处开始的两个积分获得的，没有任何拟合，并且它相对于 $M$ 的导数是对相同的两个解的积分，因此梯度不需要自己的积分。我们使用速度来研究圆顶无法确定的 $M$ 部分，在最低掺杂水平处的值 $\Fsq$ 与 $\Fsq=0$ 之间的区间，其中 $M$ 是固定对偶算子维数的标量质量 $M(0)$。

我们将标量质量保持在几个值（我们称之为固定质量），在每个值上重新训练其他所有值，并发现无论圆顶的地平线达到什么位置（包括 $M$ 的最小值），重建结果都是一致的，并且仅在该区间上有所不同。使用最简单的封闭形式进行重建的规则可以恢复测试圆顶的标量质量和质量函数。然而，在高斯和双高斯圆顶以及 YBa$_{2}$Cu$_{3}$O$_{y}$ 和 2M-WS$_{2}$ 的测量相图上，它保持的固定质量依赖于连接或窄边距，因此对于这些目标，标量质量保持开放。因此，圆顶限制了 $M$ 其视野范围，并且固定对偶算子的维数需要第二个可观测量。

title: The Komar charges of type~II supergravity and supersymmetric localization

We study different rewritings of this charge in terms of Page charges and forms with special properties that are used in the derivation of thermodynamical relations in black $p$-brane spacetimes. title: A toy model for the quark pole mass
abstract: We study the pole mass for a heavy quark probe in the Gross--Neveu model, at the first non-trivial order in the $1/N$ expansion. We show that this mass suffers from a perturbative renormalon ambiguity structurally similar to the one in QCD. The exact large $N$ solution leads however to an explicit expression for the pole mass which can be decoded as a trans-series, and we find that non-perturbative corrections cure the renormalon ambiguity. We also calculate the self-energy of the heavy quark beyond perturbation theory by using the OPE method with condensates, and show that the results are in agreement with the large $N$ solution. The non-perturbative corrections to the pole mass turn out to be determined to a large extent by the condensate corrections to the self-energy. However, there is a class of corrections that has to be reorganized due to on-shell effects and cannot be obtained from the conventional condensate expansion. We discuss possible implications of this toy model for QCD.
summary: We study the pole mass for a heavy quark probe in the Gross--Neveu model, at the first non-trivial order in the $1/N$ expansion. We show that this mass suffers from a perturbative renormalon ambiguity structurally similar to the one in QCD.然而，精确的大 $N$ 解导致了极质量的显式表达式，可以将其解码为反序列，并且我们发现非微扰校正可以解决重整模糊性。我们还利用凝聚体的OPE方法超越微扰理论计算了重夸克的自能，并表明结果与大$N$解一致。 The non-perturbative corrections to the pole mass turn out to be determined to a large extent by the condensate corrections to the self-energy.然而，有一类校正由于壳上效应而必须重新组织，并且不能从传统的凝析油膨胀中获得。 We discuss possible implications of this toy model for QCD.

title: A Superfluid at All Temperatures
abstract: We construct unitary, local, 3+1-dimensional conformal field theories with finitely many fields whose thermal state breaks a continuous global symmetry at every temperature. They are finite-$N$ versions of the Chaudhuri--Choi--Rabinovici theories, whose planar circle of fixed points has an ordered arc. The circle is lifted at order $1/N^2$, and an infinite family of fixed points on this arc reaches arbitrarily weak coupling, where the superfluid is under parametric control. We also show that weakly gauging the symmetry gives a superconductor over an exponential range of temperatures.
summary: 我们构建了酉、局部、3+1 维共形场论，其中有限多个场的热状态在每个温度下都打破了连续的全局对称性。它们是 Chaudhuri-Choi-Rabinovici 理论的有限 $N$ 版本，其不动点的平面圆具有有序弧。该圆以 $1/N^2$ 的顺序提升，并且该弧上的无限系列固定点达到任意弱耦合，其中超流体处于参数控制之下。我们还表明，弱测量对称性可以在指数温度范围内产生超导体。

title: Maximally symmetric black holes with torsion in Lovelock gravity
abstract: We analyze the existence of static black hole solutions with maximally symmetric horizons and nontrivial torsion in five-dimensional Lovelock gravity. For each symmetry class, we obtain a black hole solution characterized by two independent constants. We also determine the conserved charges associated with these solutions.
summary: 我们分析了五维洛夫洛克引力中具有最大对称视界和非平凡扭转的静态黑洞解的存在性。对于每个对称类，我们获得一个由两个独立常数表征的黑洞解。我们还确定与这些解决方案相关的保守费用。

title: Black hole radial geometry from a quantum spin chain
abstract: We show that the radial differential equation for a scalar field in an anti-de Sitter black brane background can be encoded in an exactly solvable semi-infinite spin chain independent of dimensionality. The radial coordinate emerges as lattice quasimomentum. Spin coherence encodes the geometry, while the spectrum and response recover gravitational observables and yield exact screening-mass sum rules. We implement the finite chain on a superconducting processor. At finite filling and low energies, the model yields a conformal field theory in a coordinate proportional to proper radial distance.
summary: 我们证明，反德西特黑膜背景中标量场的径向微分方程可以编码为与维数无关的精确可解的半无限自旋链。径向坐标表现为格子准动量。自旋相干性对几何结构进行编码，而光谱和响应则恢复引力可观测值并产生精确的筛选质量和规则。我们在超导处理器上实现有限链。在有限填充和低能量下，该模型在与适当的径向距离成比例的坐标中产生共形场论。

title: Null string holography in AdS from local BRST descent
abstract: We show that the radial sector of a Carroll-Weyl gauged null string in Poincaré $\mathrm{AdS}_D$ is locally trivial in BRST cohomology. In a quotient-adapted BFV basis, the radial coordinate, its conjugate momentum, and the associated ghosts form a contractible quartet. An explicit contracting homotopy extends this reduction to the full algebra of local spatial jets, leaving precisely the $(D-1)$-dimensional ILST BRST complex. The same quartet carries zero net Virasoro central charge, so that the anomaly condition of the parent theory, $D=27$, descends to the ILST condition $d=26$.
summary: 我们证明，Poincaré $\mathrm{AdS}_D$ 中 Carroll-Weyl 规范空串的径向扇区在 BRST 上同调中是局部平凡的。在商自适应 BFV 基础中，径向坐标、其共轭动量以及相关的重影形成可收缩的四重奏。显式收缩同伦将这种简化扩展到局部空间射流的完整代数，精确地留下 $(D-1)$ 维 ILST BRST 复形。同一个四重奏的净 Virasoro 中心电荷为零，因此父理论的异常条件 $D=27$ 下降到 ILST 条件 $d=26$。

title: Matrix Product State Representatives of Symmetry-Protected Phases
abstract: We provide a simple ansatz for finding integer spin $SO(3)\times\Z_2^T\times\Z_2^R$-invariant matrix product states representing a phase for each triple of $\Z_2$ topological indices studied in the literature by Tasaki \cite{tasakiheistop}\cite{tasakitop} and Ogata (corresponding to time-reversal and reflection symmetries) \cite{ogatatime}\cite{ogatareflection}. Every combination of trivial and non-trivial indices has a spin-$1$ $SU(2)$, time-reversal, and site-reflection symmetric MPS representative with injectivity length $l\leq 8$. We provide some exact examples for spin-$1$ and a Fortran program which will find representatives of any triple for any integer spin, as well as some data from random sampling for small spin. The existence of such states agrees with the classification of Chen, Gu, and Wen \cite{chen}, and with the recent results of Tasaki \cite{tasakinew} equating the hidden-order and one of Ogata's indices, wherein the Ogata index is that associated to the dihedral $D_2$ symmetry.
summary: 我们提供了一个简单的 ansatz 来查找整数自旋 $SO(3)\times\Z_2^T\times\Z_2^R$ 不变矩阵乘积状态，表示 Tasaki \cite{tasakiheistop}\cite{tasakitop} 和 Ogata 文献中研究的 $\Z_2$ 拓扑索引的每个三元组的一个相位（对应于时间反转和反射对称性） \cite{ogatatime}\cite{ogatareflection}。平凡指数和非平凡指数的每个组合都有自旋 $1$ $SU(2)$、时间反转和位点反射对称 MPS 代表，单射性长度为 $l\leq 8$。我们提供了一些关于 spin-$1$ 的精确示例和一个 Fortran 程序，该程序将找到任何整数自旋的任何三元组的代表，以及来自小自旋的随机采样的一些数据。这种状态的存在符合 Chen、Gu 和 Wen \cite{chen} 的分类，也符合 Tasaki \cite{tasakinew} 将隐藏序与 Ogata 指数之一等同的最新结果，其中 Ogata 指数与二面体 $D_2$ 对称性相关。

title: Absence of Absolutely Continuous Spectrum for One-Dimensional Capacitance Operators with Critical Long-Range Interactions
abstract: In this paper, we establish the absence of absolutely continuous spectrum for scalar one-dimensional Laurent operators with multiplicative disorder and critical long-range hoppings. In particular, the requirement of at least quartic off-diagonal decay rate in the existing theory is bypassed by exploiting the finite-difference bound of the convolution kernel, which is available even when the interaction decays only as $|n|^{-1}\log^{-\beta}|n|$ with $\beta>1$. We then apply the abstract main result to a concrete physical model, the capacitance operator in subwavelength physics. For a chain of three-dimensional resonators with one resonator per period, we verify the required decay and finite-difference estimates and conclude the absence of absolutely continuous spectrum. These results leave open the distinction between pure point and singular continuous spectrum, but constitute a key step in proving Anderson localization in wave systems with critical long-range interactions.
summary: 在本文中，我们建立了具有乘性无序和临界长程跳跃的标量一维洛朗算子不存在绝对连续谱。特别是，通过利用卷积核的有限差分界限，绕过了现有理论中至少四次非对角线衰减率的要求，即使当相互作用仅衰减为 $|n|^{-1}\log^{-\beta}|n|$ 且 $\beta>1$ 时，该限制也是可用的。然后，我们将抽象的主要结果应用于具体的物理模型，即亚波长物理中的电容算子。对于每个周期一个谐振器的一系列三维谐振器，我们验证了所需的衰减和有限差分估计，并得出不存在绝对连续谱的结论。这些结果留下了纯点和奇异连续谱之间的区别，但构成了证明具有关键长程相互作用的波系统中安德森定域性的关键一步。

title: Operator Schmidt Rank and the Geometry of Schmidt Profiles
abstract: The main result of the paper states that if $0\neq v\in\mathbb C^m\otimes\mathbb C^n$, $d=\min\{m,n\}$, and $p=SR(v)$, then for every $1\le q\le d$, \begin{equation*} \min\left\{OSR(\mathbf U): \begin{array}{l} \mathbf U\in\mathbb M_m\otimes\mathbb M_n\text{ is unitary}, SR(\mathbf Uv)=q \end{array}\right\} = \left\lceil\max\left\{\frac pq,\frac qp\right\}\right\rceil . \end{equation*} Here $OSR(\mathbf U)$ denotes the operator Schmidt rank of $\mathbf U$. Furthermore, if $\mathbf U\in\mathbb M_m\otimes\mathbb M_n$ is unitary and $OSR(\mathbf U)\le k$, then, for every unit vector $x\in\mathbb C^m\otimes\mathbb C^n$ and every $1\le r\le d$, \begin{equation*} F_{\min\{kr,d\}}(\mathbf Ux)\ge F_r(x) \quad\text{and}\quad F_{\min\{kr,d\}}(x)\ge F_r(\mathbf Ux), \end{equation*} where $F_r(x)$ denotes the sum of the $r$ largest squared Schmidt coefficients of $x$. This result is stronger than rank reachability as it controls the entire cumulative Schmidt profile. We also establish a majorization relation and use it to obtain sharp bounds on Schatten-norm distortion and on the change of Rényi entropies under unitaries with bounded operator Schmidt rank.
summary: 论文的主要结果表明，如果 $0\neq v\in\mathbb C^m\otimes\mathbb C^n$、$d=\min\{m,n\}$ 和 $p=SR(v)$，则对于每个 $1\le q\le d$，\begin{equation*} \min\left\{OSR(\mathbf U): \begin{array}{l} \mathbf U\in\mathbb M_m\otimes\mathbb M_n\text{ 是酉}， SR(\mathbf Uv)=q \end{array}\right\} = \left\lceil\max\left\{\frac pq,\frac qp\right\}\right\rceil 。 \end{equation*} 这里 $OSR(\mathbf U)$ 表示 $\mathbf U$ 的算子施密特秩。此外，如果 $\mathbf U\in\mathbb M_m\otimes\mathbb M_n$ 是酉且 $OSR(\mathbf U)\le k$，则对于每个单位向量 $x\in\mathbb C^m\otimes\mathbb C^n$ 和每个 $1\le r\le d$，\begin{equation*} F_{\min\{kr,d\}}(\mathbf Ux)\ge F_r(x) \quad\text{和}\quad F_{\min\{kr,d\}}(x)\ge F_r(\mathbf Ux), \end{equation*} 其中 $F_r(x)$ 表示 $x$ 的 $r$ 最大施密特系数平方之和。该结果比排名可达性更强，因为它控制整个累积施密特配置文件。我们还建立了一个主化关系，并用它来获得 Schatten 范数畸变和具有有界算子 Schmidt 秩的幺正下 Rényi 熵变化的锐界。

title: Asymptotic Neutrality for the Ionization Conjecture in the Two-Center Thomas-Fermi-Dirac-von Weizsäcker Theory
abstract: The ionization conjecture for the Thomas-Fermi-Dirac-von Weizsäcker model asks how many electrons a given nuclear configuration can bind. So far, only the single-center case has been settled by Frank, Nam, and Van Den Bosch, while the original molecular case has still remained open. We advance this conjecture in the two-center case. We prove that for two distinct nuclei of total charge $Z$, the number $N$ of bound electrons satisfies $N\le Z+C Z^{153/154}(1+\log Z)^{3/8}$, with constants independent of the nuclear positions and the nuclear charges. The proof relies on a comparison with the neutral Thomas-Fermi density and on localization and exterior $L^1$-estimates coupled through the screened potential. Our results could be extended to molecules with any fixed number $K$ of nuclei.
summary: Thomas-Fermi-Dirac-von Weizsäcker 模型的电离猜想询问给定的核构型可以结合多少个电子。到目前为止，Frank、Nam 和 Van Den Bosch 只解决了单中心案件，而最初的分子案件仍然悬而未决。我们在两个中心的情况下提出这个猜想。我们证明，对于总电荷 $Z$ 的两个不同的原子核，束缚电子的数量 $N$ 满足 $N\le Z+C Z^{153/154}(1+\log Z)^{3/8}$，其常数与核位置和核电荷无关。该证明依赖于与中性托马斯-费米密度的比较以及通过筛选势耦合的局部化和外部 $L^1$ 估计。我们的结果可以扩展到具有任何固定数量 $K$ 原子核的分子。

title: Iterated Graph Systems (II): Bernoulli percolation and critical-exponent universality classes on hierarchical lattices
abstract: We study Bernoulli percolation and its universality classes on hierarchical lattices generated by edge iterated graph systems (EIGS). By examining eight critical exponents, we prove that no finite family of substitution-multiplicative dimensions completely determines universality, providing a rigorous proof of the failure of dimension-based universality discussed by Hauser and Saxena [Phys. Rev. B 34 (1986), 8193-8195]. Although the six exponentials theorem provides number-theoretic criteria for scale commensurability, we further disprove the conjecture that critical-exponent universality requires commensurate discrete renormalisation scales.
summary: 我们研究伯努利渗滤及其在边迭代图系统（EIGS）生成的分层格上的普遍性类。通过检查八个关键指数，我们证明没有有限族的替代乘法维度可以完全决定普遍性，为 Hauser 和 Saxena 讨论的基于维度的普遍性的失败提供了严格的证明。 Rev. B 34 (1986), 8193-8195]。尽管六指数定理为尺度可通约性提供了数论标准，但我们进一步反驳了临界指数普遍性需要相应离散重正化尺度的猜想。

title: Visualizing two qubits
abstract: I propose a simple visualization for pure two-qubit states, constructed from three components: two Bloch balls for the marginal qubits (the mixed states obtained by ignoring the other qubit, respectively) and an entanglement component consisting of a rotoreflection and a contraction. I prove that this picture accurately captures the local and global structure of the relevant state space without gaps or degeneracies: the underlying parametrization is a global diffeomorphism onto the state space. Finally, I use this picture to visualize conditional states, the entanglement degree(s) of freedom, and single qubit rotations.
summary: 我提出了一种纯双量子位状态的简单可视化，由三个组件构成：两个用于边缘量子位的布洛赫球（分别通过忽略另一个量子位获得的混合状态）和一个由旋转反射和收缩组成的纠缠组件。我证明这张图准确地捕捉了相关状态空间的局部和全局结构，没有间隙或简并：底层参数化是状态空间上的全局微分同胚。最后，我使用这张图片来可视化条件状态、纠缠自由度和单个量子位旋转。

title: Efficiently computable bounds on the energy-constrained quantum reading capacity
abstract: In quantum reading, classical messages are encoded in sequences of quantum channels and recovered by probing the channels and processing their outputs. We study the reading capacity of a finite family of finite-dimensional channels under an average constraint on the probing energy, allowing arbitrary adaptive operations between channel uses. Using an input-dependent chain rule for the Belavkin-Staszewski relative entropy, we derive a converse bound expressed as an optimization involving channel Choi operators and the operator relative entropy. This formulation admits semidefinite approximations and reduces, without an energy constraint, to a channel information radius. To obtain achievable rates, we construct bilinear semidefinite lower approximations to a standard non-adaptive reading bound. Alternating optimization produces feasible probe states and encoding distributions, whose Holevo information gives a directly evaluable achievable rate. For jointly classical-quantum channels, we derive a separate converse based on the Umegaki relative entropy. Without an energy constraint, this converse matches a non-adaptive achievable rate, recovering a recent result of Pascual Abraldes and Winter: non-adaptive protocols suffice to achieve the unconstrained reading capacity of jointly classical-quantum channels.
summary:
在量子读取中，经典消息被编码在量子通道序列中，并通过探测通道并处理其输出来恢复。我们研究了在探测能量的平均约束下有限族有限维通道的读取能力，允许通道使用之间的任意自适应操作。使用 Belavkin-Staszewski 相对熵的输入相关链式法则，我们导出了一个逆界，表示为涉及通道 Choi 算子和算子相对熵的优化。该公式允许半定近似，并且在没有能量约束的情况下减少到信道信息半径。为了获得可实现的速率，我们构建了标准非自适应阅读界限的双线性半定下近似。交替优化产生可行的探针状态和编码分布，其 Holevo 信息给出了可直接评估的可实现速率。对于联合经典量子通道，我们基于 Umegaki 相对熵导出一个单独的逆。

在没有能量约束的情况下，这个逆过程匹配非自适应可实现的速率，恢复了 Pascual Abraldes 和 Winter 的最新结果：非自适应协议足以实现联合经典量子通道的无约束读取能力。

title: An efficient variational polaron master equation for non-Markovian spin-boson dynamics: Transformed initial states and general observables
abstract: We investigate the effects of initial states on the dynamics of a quantum spin-boson model using an efficient variational polaron master equation approach. The transformation of a factorized system-environment initial state into the variational polaron frame introduces inhomogeneous terms in the master equation, essential for accurately describing non-Markovian dynamics beyond the weak coupling regime. To efficiently account for these effects, we formulate the dynamics in an extended auxiliary Liouville space, converting the resulting integro-differential equations into coupled ordinary differential equations. We further introduce a simplified variational polaron technique for computing the time evolution of expectation values of general observables, including those that do not commute with the polaron transformation, overcoming a major limitation of previous approaches and enabling the unified treatment of coherence and population dynamics. The effects of transformed initial states generated from arbitrary factorized initial states are systematically characterized through expectation values and trace-distance analysis, providing insight into the associated bath-relaxation dynamics over a broad range of tunneling amplitudes, temperatures, and coupling strengths. Comparison with the weak-coupling master equation reveals a delay phenomenon associated with multi-bath-quanta processes, pronounced at intermediate coupling strengths and tunneling amplitudes. We further show that coherent superposition initial states induce stronger nonequilibrium effects than localized states, with inhomogeneous terms playing a crucial role in the short-time dynamics. The proposed formalism applies to both undriven and resonantly driven spin-boson models, providing a computationally efficient framework for open quantum-system dynamics with arbitrary factorized initial states and general physical observables.
summary:
我们使用有效的变分极化子主方程方法研究初始态对量子自旋玻色子模型动力学的影响。将因式分解的系统环境初始状态转换为变分极化子框架在主方程中引入了非齐次项，这对于准确描述弱耦合范围之外的非马尔可夫动力学至关重要。为了有效地解释这些影响，我们在扩展的辅助刘维尔空间中制定了动力学，将所得的积分微分方程转换为耦合常微分方程。我们进一步引入了一种简化的变分极化子技术，用于计算一般可观测值的期望值的时间演化，包括那些不与极化子变换交换的观测值，克服了先前方法的主要限制，并能够统一处理相干性和总体动态。

通过期望值和迹距离分析系统地表征从任意因式分解初始状态生成的变换初始状态的影响，从而深入了解在广泛的隧道振幅、温度和耦合强度下相关的浴弛豫动力学。与弱耦合主方程的比较揭示了与多浴量子过程相关的延迟现象，在中间耦合强度和隧道振幅时明显。我们进一步表明，相干叠加初始态比局域态引起更强的非平衡效应，其中非齐次项在短时动力学中起着至关重要的作用。所提出的形式主义适用于非驱动和共振驱动的自旋玻色子模型，为具有任意分解初始状态和一般物理可观测量的开放量子系统动力学提供了计算有效的框架。

title: Interaction-Assisted Spin Coherence in a Multimode Trapped Atomic Ensemble
abstract: In a thermally occupied multimode trapped ensemble, mode-dependent detunings can strongly suppress Ramsey contrast even when the underlying dynamics remains coherent. We develop a weak-axis-resolved Hamiltonian theory in which collective mode spins experience longitudinal detunings and overlap-dependent exchange interactions. Without exchange, the distribution of detunings across thermally occupied modes produces coherent phase mixing and an algebraically decaying Ramsey-contrast envelope in the many-mode continuum regime. At the mean-field level, exchange generates a self-consistent restoring field that reduces phase dispersion and restores collective contrast. The crossover is governed by the competition between the collective exchange scale and the thermally induced detuning spread: when the late-time contrast is expressed in terms of their ratio, results at different temperatures collapse onto a common trend, and the crossover coupling follows the predicted inverse-square thermal scaling, with a numerical exponent of 2.06. Weak irreversible pure dephasing limits, but does not eliminate, this recovery, demonstrating that exchange refocuses coherent inhomogeneous phase mixing but cannot reverse irreversible phase noise.
summary:
在热占据的多模俘获系综中，即使底层动力学保持相干，与模式相关的失谐也可以强烈抑制拉姆齐对比度。我们开发了一种弱轴解析的哈密顿理论，其中集体模式自旋经历纵向失谐和重叠依赖的交换相互作用。在没有交换的情况下，热占据模式上的失谐分布会在多模连续区中产生相干相混合和代数衰减的拉姆齐对比度包络。在平均场水平上，交换产生自洽的恢复场，减少相位色散并恢复集体对比度。交叉由集体交换规模和热引起的失谐扩散之间的竞争决定：当后期对比以它们的比率表示时，不同温度下的结果崩溃到共同趋势，并且交叉耦合遵循预测的平方反比热缩放，数值指数为2.06。

弱不可逆纯相移限制但不能消除这种恢复，表明交换重新聚焦相干非均匀相位混合但不能逆转不可逆相位噪声。

title: When the coupler is the channel: an AND condition on cavity photon-number means
abstract: Can two cavities have equal mean photon numbers whenever at least one of two binary controls is off, and unequal means only when both controls are on? We give an elementary construction using a two-pump beam-splitter interaction whose strength is proportional to the product of the controls. A phase-coherent single-excitation state yields mean occupations $(1/2,1/2)$ for inputs $00$, $01$, and $10$, and $(1,0)$ for input $11$. This realizes the desired AND condition exactly at the level of population means. It also makes the communication resource explicit: the interaction acts after the inputs are supplied and changes local statistics with the remote input. For any no-signalling distribution with finite means, the corresponding exact-mean score is at most $3/4$ under uniform inputs. We give a robust consistency inequality, a finite-sample counting protocol, and a coherent-state realization showing that this mean response does not require entanglement. The construction provides a concrete example for distinguishing controlled interactions from nonlocal-game resources.
summary: 当两个二元控制中的至少一个关闭时，两个腔是否可以具有相等的平均光子数，并且只有当两个控制都打开时才意味着不相等？我们给出了使用双泵浦分束器相互作用的基本结构，其强度与控制的乘积成正比。相位相干单激励状态对于输入 $00$、$01$ 和 $10$ 产生平均占据 $(1/2,1/2)$，对于输入 $11$ 产生平均占据 $(1,0)$。这恰好在总体均值水平上实现了所需的 AND 条件。它还使通信资源变得明确：交互在提供输入后进行，并通过远程输入更改本地统计数据。对于任何具有有限均值的无信号分布，在均匀输入下相应的精确均值得分最多为 $3/4$。我们给出了鲁棒的一致性不等式、有限样本计数协议和相干态实现，表明这种平均响应不需要纠缠。该构造提供了区分受控交互与非本地游戏资源的具体示例。

title: Cross-Validation of Open-Source Quantum Network Simulators
abstract: We present a comparative analysis of two open-source quantum network simulators, QuISP and SeQUeNCe, focusing on cross-validation of basic networking tasks to ensure consistency and accuracy in simulation outputs. Although both simulators are designed to study quantum network management policies and their dynamics under complex noise models, their differing underlying assumptions can lead to variations in simulation results. We highlight the discrepancies in how the two simulators handle connections, internal network node processing time, and classical communication, resulting in significant quantitative and qualitative differences in the time required to perform basic network tasks such as entanglement generation, purification, and swapping. We simulate common scenarios between the simulators to compare both the latency of resource distribution and the fidelity of the distributed resources. Our findings indicate that while the simulators differ in the time required to complete network tasks---a constant factor difference attributable to their respective connection models---they agree on the fidelity of the distributed resources under identical error parameters. This work demonstrates a crucial first step towards enhancing the reliability and reproducibility of quantum network simulations, as well as leading to full protocol development. Furthermore, our benchmarking methodology establishes a foundational set of tasks for the cross-validation of simulators to study future quantum networks.
summary:
我们对两个开源量子网络模拟器 QuISP 和 SeQUeNCe 进行了比较分析，重点是基本网络任务的交叉验证，以确保模拟输出的一致性和准确性。尽管这两个模拟器都旨在研究复杂噪声模型下的量子网络管理策略及其动态，但它们不同的基本假设可能会导致模拟结果的变化。我们强调了两个模拟器在处理连接、内部网络节点处理时间和经典通信方面的差异，导致执行基本网络任务（例如纠缠生成、净化和交换）所需的时间存在显着的定量和定性差异。我们模拟模拟器之间的常见场景，以比较资源分配的延迟和分布式资源的保真度。我们的研究结果表明，虽然模拟器在完成网络任务所需的时间上有所不同（由于各自的连接模型而存在恒定的因素差异），但它们在相同误差参数下的分布式资源的保真度上是一致的。

这项工作展示了增强量子网络模拟的可靠性和可重复性以及实现完整协议开发的关键的第一步。此外，我们的基准测试方法为模拟器的交叉验证建立了一组基本任务，以研究未来的量子网络。

title: Building codes with transversal CCZ using projective geometry and SAT solvers
abstract: We construct CSS codes with three logical qubits whose logical CCZ gate is implemented by transversal physical $T/T^{\dagger}$ gates and whose distance is at least $3$. These codes start with $8$-divisible $X$-stabilizers defined by projective geometry, which guarantees $d_Z\geq 3$. A SAT solver then finds three $X$-logical operators compatible with the transversal CCZ. We build codes at thirteen block lengths from $n=48$ to $n=496$, with $d_Z=3$ or $4$, and illustrate the method with the $[[48,3,3]]$ code $Q_{48}$. Additionally, we prove that no CSS code with three logical qubits, $Z$-distance at least $3$, and a quasi-transversal CCZ gate (transversal $T$ with a diagonal Clifford correction) exists below $n=39$. The $[[47,3,3]]$ code of Jacinto et al. serves as an upper bound, leaving $39\leq n\leq46$ open.
summary: 我们用三个逻辑量子位构建 CSS 代码，其逻辑 CCZ 门由横向物理 $T/T^{\dagger}$ 门实现，其距离至少为 $3$。这些代码以由射影几何定义的 $8$ 整除的 $X$ 稳定器开始，保证 $d_Z\geq 3$。然后，SAT 求解器会找到与横向 CCZ 兼容的三个 $X$ 逻辑运算符。我们以从 $n=48$ 到 $n=496$ 的 13 个块长度构建代码，其中 $d_Z=3$ 或 $4$，并使用 $[[48,3,3]]$ 代码 $Q_{48}$ 说明该方法。此外，我们证明在 $n=39$ 以下不存在具有三个逻辑量子位、$Z$ 距离至少 $3$ 和准横向 CCZ 门（带有对角 Clifford 校正的横向 $T$）的 CSS 代码。 Jacinto 等人的 $[[47,3,3]]$ 代码。作为上限，$39\leq n\leq46$ 保持开放状态。

title: Non-Orthogonal Amplitude Amplification for Hybrid CV-DV Quantum Processors
abstract: We introduce a non-orthogonal amplitude amplification (NOAA) method for hybrid continuous-variable- discrete-variable (CV-DV) quantum processors, where the available CV-assisted projector is not perfectly se- lective for the target state. We establish a bound on the achievable target-state fidelity, which is determined by the initial target-state amplitude and the selectivity of the accessible reflection operator. This bound limits the performance of NOAA in hybrid CV-DV systems. To mitigate this limitation, we propose using a squeezed CV ancilla to reduce the overlap between relevant CV states and a hybrid quantum signal processing (HQSP) filter to suppress errors arising from imperfect knowledge of the target eigenenergy. Numerical simulations show that, for small initial target-state amplitudes, our protocol achieves higher fidelity and efficiency than the repeat-until-success (RUS) method despite the presence of non-orthogonality. For large initial amplitudes, RUS is already efficient, and amplitude amplification provides little additional advantage.
summary: 我们引入了一种用于混合连续变量-离散变量（CV-DV）量子处理器的非正交幅度放大（NOAA）方法，其中可用的CV辅助投影仪对目标状态不能完全选择性。我们建立了可实现的目标状态保真度的界限，该界限由初始目标状态幅度和可访问反射算子的选择性决定。这种限制限制了 NOAA 在混合 CV-DV 系统中的性能。为了缓解这一限制，我们建议使用压缩 CV 辅助来减少相关 CV 状态之间的重叠，并使用混合量子信号处理 (HQSP) 滤波器来抑制由于对目标本征能量的不完善了解而产生的错误。数值模拟表明，对于较小的初始目标状态振幅，尽管存在非正交性，但我们的协议比重复直到成功（RUS）方法实现了更高的保真度和效率。对于大的初始振幅，RUS 已经很有效，而振幅放大几乎没有提供额外的优势。

title: Distance Structure of Insertion Kernels and Local Port Response in Non-Reciprocal Su--Schrieffer--Heeger Chains
abstract: Non-reciprocal lattices offer a flexible setting for directional wave transport, raising the question of how enhanced internal scattering translates into transmission between fixed external ports. We address this question for non-reciprocal Su--Schrieffer--Heeger (SSH) chains with staggered gain and loss by relating the reference-dependent insertion kernel $K_p=VG_pV$ to the coherent transmission intensity $T$. On a fixed finite graph, a strong-insertion expansion gives a contribution proportional to $\gamma^{1-d}$, whose coefficient is the signed sum of shortest directed paths of length $d$. When this sum is nonzero, it sets the leading behavior independently of fixed diagonal losses; when it cancels, those losses can enter the first surviving higher-order term. For a fixed cross-sublattice endpoint channel, transmission has a strictly negative slope at every nonzero differentiable stationary point of the kernel magnitude. In the weak-insertion regime, the reference-system coefficient $\chi=-\mathrm{Re}\,\mathrm{Tr}[(G_{0p}Z)^2]$ predicts the initial transmission change for symmetric SSH ports, and $\chi>0$ together with a strictly stable baseline guarantees local stable enhancement. Finite-chain calculations and driven dynamics connect these results to observable response and distinguish asymptotic convergence from transient settling. A strictly dissipative short-chain example exhibits local enhancement without net power gain. Together, these results separate graph-path structure, coherent port response, and dynamical establishment, providing channel-specific criteria for interpreting internal scattering.
summary:
非互易晶格为定向波传输提供了灵活的设置，从而提出了增强的内部散射如何转化为固定外部端口之间的传输的问题。我们通过将参考相关插入内核 $K_p=VG_pV$ 与相干传输强度 $T$ 相关联，解决了具有交错增益和损耗的非互易 Su--Schrieffer--Heeger (SSH) 链的问题。在固定的有限图上，强插入展开给出与 $\gamma^{1-d}$ 成比例的贡献，其系数是长度为 $d$ 的最短有向路径的符号和。当该总和非零时，它设置独立于固定对角线损失的主导行为；当它取消时，这些损失可以进入第一个幸存的高阶项。对于固定的跨子晶格端点通道，传输在核幅度的每个非零可微驻点处具有严格的负斜率。

在弱插入机制中，参考系统系数 $\chi=-\mathrm{Re}\,\mathrm{Tr}[(G_{0p}Z)^2]$ 预测对称 SSH 端口的初始传输变化，并且 $\chi>0$ 与严格稳定的基线一起保证局部稳定增强。有限链计算和驱动动力学将这些结果与可观察的响应联系起来，并将渐近收敛与瞬态沉降区分开来。严格耗散的短链示例表现出局部增强而没有净功率增益。总之，这些结果将图形路径结构、相干端口响应和动态建立分开，为解释内部散射提供了特定于通道的标准。

title: The Geometry of Lee-Yang Tensors
abstract: We provide a geometric description of Lee-Yang tensors, building upon several recent results of Bravyi, Gosset, Liu, and Wong. By applying tools from complex Perron-Frobenius theory, we generalize one of their key lemmas to bound the spectral ratio of non-normal operators with Lee-Yang radius greater than one. As a direct consequence, we provide a local-to-global principle for bounding spectral gaps of Suzuki-Fisher Hamiltonians, a family of $2$-local Hamiltonians, using only the Lee-Yang radius of each local operator to bound the gap from below. On the other hand, we develop a simple perturbative technique to show that the Gibbs states of $k$-local Hamiltonians, $k \geq 3$, cannot have Lee-Yang radius at least one for all inverse temperatures $\beta \geq 0$. We apply this same method to conclude that Suzuki-Fisher Hamiltonians are precisely those Hamiltonians whose Gibbs states are Lee-Yang at all inverse temperatures $\beta \geq 0$.
summary: 我们基于 Bravyi、Gosset、Liu 和 Wong 的一些最新结果，提供了 Lee-Yang 张量的几何描述。通过应用复杂 Perron-Frobenius 理论的工具，我们推广了其关键引理之一，以限制 Lee-Yang 半径大于 1 的非正规算子的谱比。作为直接结果，我们提供了一个局部到全局的原理来限制 Suzuki-Fisher Hamiltonian 的谱间隙，这是一个由 2$ 局部哈密顿量组成的族，仅使用每个局部算子的 Lee-Yang 半径来从下面限制间隙。另一方面，我们开发了一种简单的微扰技术来证明 $k$ 局部哈密顿量的吉布斯状态 $k \geq 3$ 对于所有逆温度 $\beta \geq 0$ 不能具有至少一个李杨半径。我们应用同样的方法得出结论，铃木-费舍尔哈密顿量正是那些在所有逆温度 $\beta \geq 0$ 下吉布斯态为李杨的哈密顿量。

title: Sample-based quantum simulation of vibrational structure of polyyne chains
abstract: Predicting anharmonic vibrational spectra is a complex computational task, which becomes quickly infeasible as molecular size and the number of vibrational basis functions increase, leading to an exponential growth of the underlying Hilbert space. Here, we employ a sample-based quantum diagonalization (SQD) framework to compute anharmonic vibrational energies and spectra. The approach combines quantum state preparation and sampling with configuration recovery, diagonalization of the Hamiltonian projected in a subspace of basis configurations, and calculation of transition-dipole moments to obtain both vibrational energies and infrared spectra. We investigate two approaches for sampling, namely, vib-LUCJ and vib-SqDRIFT and apply the method to study the polyyne molecules C$_2$H$_2$ and C$_4$H$_2$, reaching representations requiring up to 104 qubits. Beyond energies, transition-dipole calculations reveal that infrared intensities and excited-state composition continue to evolve with basis size through anharmonic mixing and intensity redistribution, even when low-energy eigenvalues appear converged. These results show that sample-based quantum subspace methods can capture spectroscopic information in vibrational spaces far beyond the regime of full diagonalization. Moreover, our simulation identify multi-state recovery and scalable projected-space treatment as central challenges for further scaling sample-based approaches.
summary:
预测非谐振动谱是一项复杂的计算任务，随着分子尺寸和振动基函数数量的增加，该任务很快变得不可行，导致基础希尔伯特空间呈指数增长。在这里，我们采用基于样本的量子对角化（SQD）框架来计算非谐振动能量和光谱。该方法将量子态制备和采样与构型恢复、在基本构型子空间中投影的哈密顿量的对角化以及过渡偶极矩的计算相结合，以获得振动能量和红外光谱。我们研究了两种采样方法，即 vib-LUCJ 和 vib-SqDRIFT，并应用该方法研究多炔分子 C$_2$H$_2$ 和 C$_4$H$_2$，达到需要最多 104 个量子位的表示。除了能量之外，跃迁偶极子计算表明，即使低能量特征值出现收敛，红外强度和激发态组成也会通过非谐混合和强度重新分布继续随基础尺寸演化。

这些结果表明，基于样本的量子子空间方法可以捕获远远超出全对角化范围的振动空间中的光谱信息。此外，我们的模拟将多状态恢复和可扩展的投影空间处理确定为进一步扩展基于样本的方法的核心挑战。

title: Quantum anomaly detection in real scarce data
abstract: Anomaly detection on small and unbalanced datasets remains very challenging in machine learning, although this scenario is common in several domains, including healthcare, cybersecurity, finance, and energy. Data augmentation and generative AI may mitigate training-data scarcity, but they often fall short because anomalies are, by definition, unpredictable, rare, and highly diverse events compared to high-probability normal data. Overfitting to pseudo-anomalies, model collapse, high-dimensional data, uninterpretable black-box models, and validation challenges are typical issues limiting their practical applicability. In this context, quantum machine learning may provide a promising and more sustainable avenue because it can enable more interpretable models with far fewer trainable parameters and smaller datasets, implementable on energy-efficient quantum hardware. Here, we propose a novel two-step hybrid classical--quantum architecture for sequential data and test it on a realistic scenario in the global energy-transition domain, i.e., automated anomaly detection in large-scale photovoltaic plants. The achieved generalization capability and competitive prediction accuracy may pave the way for new hybrid learning models able to exploit the continuously increasing power of cloud-available and more sustainable quantum accelerators integrated with more traditional energy-hungry High Performance Computing resources.
summary:
尽管这种情况在医疗保健、网络安全、金融和能源等多个领域很常见，但小型且不平衡数据集的异常检测在机器学习中仍然非常具有挑战性。数据增强和生成式人工智能可能会缓解训练数据的稀缺性，但它们往往存在不足，因为根据定义，与高概率的正常数据相比，异常是不可预测的、罕见的和高度多样化的事件。伪异常的过度拟合、模型崩溃、高维数据、无法解释的黑盒模型以及验证挑战是限制其实际适用性的典型问题。在这种情况下，量子机器学习可能提供一个有前途且更可持续的途径，因为它可以使用更少的可训练参数和更小的数据集实现更多可解释的模型，并且可以在节能的量子硬件上实现。在这里，我们提出了一种新颖的用于序列数据的两步混合经典量子架构，并在全球能源转型领域的现实场景（即大型光伏电站的自动异常检测）上对其进行了测试。

所实现的泛化能力和有竞争力的预测精度可能为新的混合学习模型铺平道路，该模型能够利用云可用且更可持续的量子加速器与更传统的耗能高性能计算资源集成的不断增强的能力。

title: Spurious zero-dispersion continua in full $(2,q)$-positivity: A linear hierarchy-depth lower bound from an exactly solvable counting operator
abstract: Variational two-particle reduced-density-matrix methods impose hierarchies of semidefinite constraints. We ask whether a fixed level of such a hierarchy can recover even an elementary many-fermion spectrum, using the dispersion test, in which a value is accepted as an eigenvalue when the minimized dispersion vanishes. For an exactly solvable operator that counts fermions in one half of the spin orbitals, whose spectrum consists of integers, we determine the complete set of accepted values at every level of the full hierarchy of particle-hole semidefinite constraints. Besides the integers, this set contains an entire interval of noninteger values unless the hierarchy level grows linearly with the particle number, and we give the exact threshold. The proof constructs explicit pseudo reduced density matrices that are diagonal in the occupation basis, obtained by continuing the occupation probabilities of a fixed-particle-number state to a noninteger particle number. Classical semidefinite constraints on occupation correlations, supplemented by nonnegative occupation-pattern probabilities, suffice to establish fermionic positivity. For this counting model the two relaxations have the same dispersion zero set, not necessarily the same feasible states, and a converse argument shows that no other false eigenvalues occur. The limitation is specific to the hierarchy: two-body inequalities that encode the integer spectrum would remove every false value but are not generated at a fixed level. We also verify that the full semidefinite constraints and their complete projection onto two-particle reduced-density-matrix space are equivalent in finite dimensions, so that the result applies equally to the polar formulation.
summary:
变分二粒子降密度矩阵方法强加了半定约束的层次结构。我们询问这种层次结构的固定级别是否可以使用色散测试来恢复基本的多费米子谱，其中当最小化色散消失时，一个值被接受为特征值。对于一个精确可解的算子，该算子计算一半自旋轨道中的费米子，其谱由整数组成，我们确定了粒子空穴半定约束的完整层次结构的每一级的完整的一组可接受的值。除了整数之外，该集合还包含整个非整数值区间，除非层次结构级别随粒子数线性增长，并且我们给出精确的阈值。该证明构造了显式伪约化密度矩阵，该矩阵在占用基础上是对角的，通过将固定粒子数状态的占用概率延续到非整数粒子数而获得。对休闲相关性的经典半定约束，辅以非负休闲模式概率，足以建立费米子正性。

对于该计数模型，两个松弛具有相同的色散零集，不一定具有相同的可行状态，并且相反的论证表明没有其他错误特征值发生。该限制特定于层次结构：对整数谱进行编码的二体不等式将消除每个错误值，但不会在固定级别生成。我们还验证了完全半定约束及其在二粒子降密度矩阵空间上的完整投影在有限维度上是等效的，因此结果同样适用于极坐标公式。

title: Pareto-optimal quantum kernel selection for unsupervised anomaly detection on real malware beaconing data
abstract: Quantum kernel methods are leading candidates for a practical quantum advantage in machine learning, but assessing that potential requires two quantities usually reported separately: how well a kernel performs on the task, and how far its geometry departs from the classical kernels available for the same problem. We introduce a fully unsupervised, multi-objective protocol that optimises simultaneously the normalised pseudo discrepancy (NPD), a label-free proxy for anomaly detection quality, and the geometric difference (GD) to a tuned classical reference kernel, selecting models from the resulting Pareto front. We apply it to malware beaconing detection in real network traffic, using a one-class support vector machine with fidelity and projected quantum kernels over four data encodings, on simulators and on IQM's 20-qubit Garnet processor. NPD-guided selection alone finds a fidelity kernel that beats the tuned classical baseline, but with a geometric difference too small to certify the gain as quantum. Projected kernels reach far larger geometric differences; the Pareto-selected one only marginally exceeds the baseline (AUC $0.782$ versus $0.765$, $g_{C\to Q}\approx 89>\sqrt{N}$ relative to that reference kernel), still below the NPD-selected fidelity kernel ($0.840$).
summary:
量子核方法是机器学习中实际量子优势的主要候选者，但评估其潜力通常需要单独报告两个量：核在任务上的表现如何，以及其几何结构与可用于同一问题的经典核的距离有多大。我们引入了一种完全无监督的多目标协议，该协议可同时优化归一化伪差异（NPD）、异常检测质量的无标签代理以及调整后的经典参考核的几何差异（GD），从生成的帕累托前沿选择模型。我们将其应用于真实网络流量中的恶意软件信标检测，在模拟器和 IQM 的 20 量子位 Garnet 处理器上使用具有保真度的一级支持向量机和超过四种数据编码的投影量子内核。仅 NPD 引导选择就可以找到一个优于调整后的经典基线的保真度内核，但几何差异太小，无法证明增益是量子的。

投影核达到更大的几何差异； Pareto 选择的仅略微超过基线（AUC $0.782$ 与 $0.765$，$g_{C\to Q}\approx 89>\sqrt{N}$ 相对于该参考内核），仍然低于 NPD 选择的保真度内核（$0.840$）。

title: A Minimal Bicomplex Extension of the Complex Scalar Algebra of Quantum Mechanics with an Ideal-Valued Sector
abstract: Standard quantum mechanics takes the complex numbers as its scalar algebra. We ask whether this complex structure is algebraically fundamental or may instead form a distinguished embedded sector of a larger commutative and associative scalar algebra. Requiring the ordinary complex sector to remain intact while admitting an additional stable complex-like analytic sector turns the latter into a proper ideal, makes zero divisors unavoidable in finite dimension, and implies a lower bound of four real dimensions. The bicomplex algebra realizes this minimum, and under an additional compatibility assumption the four-dimensional realization is unique up to isomorphism. The resulting algebra exhibits two distinct decompositions: the canonical decomposition into orthogonal idempotent ideals and a decomposition adapted to the embedded complex sector and the additional ideal-valued sector. The ordinary complex scalars therefore lie diagonally across the canonical idempotent decomposition. The ideal sector supports Taylor series, oscillatory exponentials, Fourier-type kernels, and Schrödinger-type expressions, and carries a formal ideal-valued eigenvalue structure. Restricting the Born rule to the embedded complex sector recovers its standard form. Whether this dual scalar architecture has physical significance beyond the algebraic framework remains an open question.
summary:
标准量子力学将复数作为其标量代数。我们问这个复杂的结构是否是代数基础，或者可能形成更大的交换和结合标量代数的一个独特的嵌入部分。要求普通复数扇区保持完整，同时允许额外的稳定的类复数解析扇区将后者转变为适当的理想，使得零除数在有限维中不可避免，并意味着四个实维的下界。双复代数实现了这个最小值，并且在附加的兼容性假设下，四维实现在同构上是唯一的。由此产生的代数表现出两种不同的分解：正交幂等理想的规范分解以及适合嵌入复数扇区和附加理想值扇区的分解。因此，普通复标量位于规范幂等分解的对角线上。理想扇区支持泰勒级数、振荡指数、傅里叶型核和薛定谔型表达式，并具有形式化的理想值特征值结构。

将玻恩规则限制在嵌入式复杂领域恢复了其标准形式。这种双标量架构是否具有代数框架之外的物理意义仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。

title: Stimulated emission for a three-level artificial atom in waveguide quantum electrodynamics
abstract: This work is devoted to a theoretical study of the interaction of a quantum three-level ladder system with a continuous electromagnetic field in a one-dimensional open waveguide. We consider a situation closely resembling stimulated emission - the scattering of a single-photon exponential pulse by an excited three-level emitter. Using the real-space formalism, we obtain an analytical expression for the wavefunction of our system. We show that, for the low anharmonicity of a three-level system inherent to a transmon (the most common type of artificial atom), the influence of the third level can have a significant effect on the system's behavior. Namely, the presence of the third level largely suppresses the stimulated emission effect if the relative anharmonicity is lower than $| \alpha_r | < 4\%$. However, for a three-level system, it is possible to obtain correlation effects such as photon bunching in the reflected field, which can also be 'switched off' by tuning the incident photon parameters.
summary: 这项工作致力于一维开放波导中量子三能级梯系统与连续电磁场相互作用的理论研究。我们考虑一种与受激发射非常相似的情况——受激三能级发射器对单光子指数脉冲的散射。使用实空间形式主义，我们获得了系统波函数的解析表达式。我们表明，对于跨原子（最常见的人造原子类型）固有的三能级系统的低非谐性，第三能级的影响可以对系统的行为产生重大影响。即，如果相对非谐度低于$|，则第三能级的存在很大程度上抑制了受激发射效应。 \alpha_r | < 4\%$。然而，对于三能级系统，可以获得相关效应，例如反射场中的光子聚集，也可以通过调整入射光子参数来“关闭”这种效应。

title: Mixed States in Quantum Rabin Oblivious Transfer
abstract: Oblivious transfer (OT) is a fundamental cryptographic primitive that is useful for realizing any two-party computation. Since information-theoretically secure perfect OT is impossible classically and quantumly, research has focused on imperfect protocols, exploring how close to perfect one can get against unbounded dishonest parties. While current approaches often make use of pure quantum states, recent work suggests that mixed quantum states may improve performance. In this paper, we investigate the use of mixed quantum states in Rabin oblivious transfer, where a sender holds one bit and a receiver learns its value with a certain probability while the sender remains ignorant of whether the receiver learned it. We present three mixed-state protocols constructed with two distinct methods, extending an existing pure-state scheme and employing a probabilistic approach, and demonstrate improved performance compared to classical and quantum pure-state protocols across varying parameters.
summary: 不经意传输 (OT) 是一种基本的加密原语，对于实现任何两方计算非常有用。由于信息理论上安全的完美 OT 在经典和量子方面都是不可能的，因此研究主要集中在不完美的协议上，探索如何接近完美来对抗无限的不诚实方。虽然当前的方法通常使用纯量子态，但最近的研究表明混合量子态可以提高性能。在本文中，我们研究了混合量子态在拉宾不经意传输中的使用，其中发送者持有一位，接收者以一定的概率获知其值，而发送者仍然不知道接收者是否获悉该值。我们提出了用两种不同方法构建的三种混合状态协议，扩展了现有的纯状态方案并采用概率方法，并在不同参数下证明了与经典和量子纯状态协议相比改进的性能。

title: Quantum Optimization of the Color-of-Money Problem on IBM Quantum Hardware: A Proof-of-Concept Study
abstract: The Color-of-Money (CoM) problem is a financial optimization challenge in which enterprises must determine how to allocate and route funds across multiple accounts, currencies, and time periods while satisfying regulatory, operational, and liquidity constraints. As the number of assets, obligations, and planning periods increases, the decision space grows rapidly, making large-scale optimization increasingly challenging for classical approaches. In this work, we present a proof-of-concept quantum implementation of the CoM problem using IBM Quantum hardware. The original optimization problem is formulated as a constrained Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP) problem and transformed into a Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization (QUBO) representation suitable for quantum execution. We employ a Variational Quantum Algorithm (VQA) with Pauli Correlation Encoding (PCE), a qubit efficient encoding technique and apply error-mitigation technique to improve solution fidelity on noisy quantum hardware. A prototype instance consisting of 3 assets, 3 obligations, and 2 time periods was executed on real IBM quantum hardware and benchmarked against classical exact solver SCIP. The quantum approach successfully reproduced the same optimal solution obtained classically, validating the correctness and feasibility of the proposed methodology. While current noisy quantum hardware does not outperform classical optimization on the evaluated small instance, the results demonstrate the feasibility of executing treasury optimization workloads on current quantum hardware and provide a foundation for future investigations.
summary:
货币颜色 (CoM) 问题是一项财务优化挑战，企业必须确定如何在多个账户、货币和时间段之间分配和传送资金，同时满足监管、运营和流动性约束。随着资产、义务和规划周期数量的增加，决策空间迅速增长，使得大规模优化对传统方法越来越具有挑战性。在这项工作中，我们使用 IBM Quantum 硬件提出了 CoM 问题的概念验证量子实现。原始优化问题被表述为约束混合整数线性规划（MILP）问题，并转换为适合量子执行的二次无约束二元优化（QUBO）表示。我们采用变分量子算法 (VQA) 和保利相关编码 (PCE)（一种量子位高效编码技术），并应用错误缓解技术来提高噪声量子硬件上的解保真度。由 3 个资产、3 个义务和 2 个时间段组成的原型实例在真实的 IBM 量子硬件上执行，并针对经典精确求解器 SCIP 进行基准测试。

量子方法成功地重现了经典获得的相同最优解，验证了所提出方法的正确性和可行性。虽然当前的噪声量子硬件在评估的小型实例上的性能并不优于经典优化，但结果证明了在当前量子硬件上执行财务优化工作负载的可行性，并为未来的研究提供了基础。

title: Redundant Records of the Past: Unifying Quantum Darwinism and Decoherent Histories
abstract: There exist two different paradigms for records in isolated quantum systems: decoherent histories (which determines which past events leave formal records) and quantum Darwinism (which determines which current events get redundantly recorded). Neither one implies the other, and connections between the two are scarcely investigated. We unify quantum Darwinism and decoherent histories based on the insight that only redundant records about past events matter. The resulting framework of past redundancy encompasses quantum Darwinism when applied to events at the current time, and it connects redundancy to decoherence of histories and the probability sum rule via the Bhattacharyya coefficient (or fidelity). Importantly, various examples show that past redundancy is a more widespread phenomenon than the fine-tuned models necessary for quantum Darwinism suggest. We thus arrive at a richer picture in which redundancy can be caused by mechanisms different from quantum Darwinism (such as macroevents or cascade structures), which emphasizes that redundancy is necessary but not sufficient for objectivity, and which, overall, allows to realistically investigate the question: how generic is redundancy in nature?
summary:
孤立量子系统中的记录存在两种不同的范式：退相干历史（决定哪些过去的事件留下正式记录）和量子达尔文主义（决定哪些当前事件被冗余记录）。两者都不暗示另一者，两者之间的联系很少被研究。我们基于这样的见解来统一量子达尔文主义和退相干历史：只有有关过去事件的冗余记录才重要。由此产生的过去冗余框架在应用于当前事件时包含了量子达尔文主义，并且它将冗余与历史的退相干以及通过巴塔查亚系数（或保真度）的概率和规则联系起来。重要的是，各种例子表明，过去的冗余是一种比量子达尔文主义所需的微调模型所暗示的更为普遍的现象。

因此，我们得到了一个更丰富的图景，其中冗余可以由不同于量子达尔文主义的机制（例如宏观事件或级联结构）引起，它强调冗余是必要的，但对于客观性来说还不够，总体而言，它允许现实地研究这个问题：本质上冗余的通用性如何？

title: Extensively degenerate superradiant phase in a giant-atom quantum Rabi ring
abstract: We show that an $N$-site quantum Rabi ring with matched giant-atom couplings has $2^N$ degenerate superradiant configurations as the atomic-to-cavity frequency ratio $\eta=\Delta/\omega$ tends to infinity. Each atom couples to two cavities two sites apart, and the photon hopping carries a phase $\pi/2$. Tuning the ratio of contact strengths to the photon hopping reduces the mean-field energy to a sum of single-site Rabi energies, with a common critical coupling for all momentum-pair sectors. The degeneracy survives quadratic quantum fluctuations despite a dispersive excitation spectrum. At finite $\eta$, second-order processes involving the local cubic anharmonicity generate a same-sublattice Ising coupling of order $\omega/\eta$, selecting ferro- and antiferro-superradiant configurations. This quantum order-by-disorder effect has no classical counterpart. Four-site calculations retaining all spin states quantitatively support the predicted energy coefficients. The separation between the induced coupling and the excitation gap allows a broad temperature interval with macroscopic photon occupation and short-range correlations between displacement signs.
summary: 我们证明，随着原子与腔频率比 $\eta=\Delta/\omega$ 趋于无穷大，具有匹配巨原子耦合的 $N$ 位量子拉比环具有 $2^N$ 简并超辐射构型。每个原子耦合到相隔两个位置的两个腔，并且光子跳跃携带相位$\pi/2$。调整接触强度与光子跳跃的比率可将平均场能量降低为单点拉比能量之和，并为所有动量对扇区提供共同的临界耦合。尽管存在色散激发光谱，但简并性仍能在二次量子涨落中幸存下来。在有限 $\eta$ 下，涉及局部三次非谐性的二阶过程生成 $\omega/\eta$ 阶的同子晶格 Ising 耦合，选择铁超辐射和反铁超辐射构型。这种量子有序无序效应没有经典的对应物。保留所有自旋态的四位点计算定量地支持了预测的能量系数。感应耦合和激发间隙之间的分离允许具有宏观光子占据的宽温度区间和位移符号之间的短程相关性。

title: Beyond Spectroscopic Strong Coupling: Operational Benchmarks for Cavity-to-Magnon Quantum Transfer
abstract:
Normal-mode splitting reveals coherent cavity--magnon hybridization but does not certify finite-time quantum-state transfer. We describe quantum transfer in a passive, linear cavity--magnon system coupled to thermal reservoirs as a thermal-loss channel specified by its coherent transmissivity $\eta$ and output-referred thermal population $
u$. For single-rail qubits, we calculate the phase-corrected average fidelity and compare it with the deterministic measure-and-prepare benchmark of $2/3$. A Bell pair shared by the cavity and an isolated reference retains reference--magnon entanglement if and only if $\eta>
u$. An input squeezed vacuum of strength $r$ yields sub-vacuum magnon fluctuations if and only if $
u<\eta(1-e^{-2r})/2$. When the initial magnon and both reservoirs have the same occupation, an analytically determined peak-transmissivity time optimizes all three tasks. These task-dependent benchmarks show that a conventional linewidth-based strong-coupling criterion does not guarantee quantum-transfer performance. Conversely, entanglement or squeezing can survive below that spectroscopic reference when the added noise is sufficiently low. These benchmarks provide quantitative targets for transfer timing and thermal-noise control in intracavity-to-magnon quantum interfaces.
summary:
简正模分裂揭示了相干腔-磁振子杂化，但不能证明有限时间量子态转移。我们将被动线性腔磁振子系统中的量子传输描述为耦合到热库的热损失通道，该热损失通道由其相干透射率 $\eta$ 和输出参考热布居 $
u$ 指定。对于单轨量子位，我们计算相位校正平均保真度，并将其与确定性测量和准备基准 $2/3$ 进行比较。当且仅当 $\eta>
u$ 时，空腔和孤立参考共享的贝尔对保留参考——磁振子纠缠。当且仅当 $
u<\eta(1-e^{-2r})/2$ 时，强度为 $r$ 的输入压缩真空会产生亚真空磁振子波动。当初始磁振子和两个储存器具有相同的占用时，通过分析确定的峰值透射率时间可以优化所有三个任务。这些与任务相关的基准测试表明，传统的基于线宽的强耦合标准不能保证量子传输性能。相反，当添加的噪声足够低时，纠缠或挤压可以在低于光谱参考的情况下继续存在。

这些基准为腔内-磁振子量子接口中的传输定时和热噪声控制提供了定量目标。

title: Moment Methods for Uniform Average Mixing on Strongly Regular Graphs
abstract: We study continuous-time quantum walks on connected strongly regular graphs that are not complete, observed at a random time drawn from a freely chosen probability law. Uniform average mixing (UAM) asks for a law under which every averaged transition probability equals $1/n$, where $n$ is the number of vertices. On a strongly regular graph this is equivalent to two affine constraints on three cosine moments. We construct a bounded, compactly supported time density for every strongly regular graph with nonintegral eigenvalues. For integral spectra we give an exact finite Toeplitz criterion and its Hankel form. Every averaged mixing matrix of such a graph is realized by at most two observation times. Three elementary inequalities on the moment line, which also give a short proof of Chan's classification of complex Hadamard matrices in the Bose-Mesner algebra, lead to a determination of all strongly regular graphs that admit UAM. Apart from the conference graphs of nonsquare order and the graphs with instantaneous uniform mixing, these are the members of two infinite families of parameter sets and their complements, and for them we give explicit laws with two observation times. The Petersen graph and its complement are the smallest members. A strongly regular graph with UAM admits a bounded time density exactly when it has no instantaneous uniform mixing. We also correct the classification of instantaneous uniform mixing on strongly regular graphs by Godsil, Mullin and Roy. Its sign condition excludes the halved $5$-cube, which mixes uniformly at time $\pi/4$. With the order $4\theta^2$ read literally, its parity condition also excludes the Clebsch graph and includes the parameters $(36,14,4,6)$, for which no time law gives uniform average mixing.
summary:
我们研究在不完整的连通强规则图上的连续时间量子行走，在根据自由选择的概率定律得出的随机时间观察到。均匀平均混合 (UAM) 要求每个平均转移概率等于 $1/n$ 的定律，其中 $n$ 是顶点数。在强正则图上，这相当于三个余弦矩上的两个仿射约束。我们为每个具有非整数特征值的强正则图构造一个有界的、紧支持的时间密度。对于积分谱，我们给出精确的有限 Toeplitz 准则及其 Hankel 形式。该图的每个平均混合矩阵最多通过两次观察时间来实现。矩线上的三个基本不等式，也给出了 Chan 对 Bose-Mesner 代数中的复 Hadamard 矩阵的分类的简短证明，导致了所有承认 UAM 的强正则图的确定。除了非方阶会议图和瞬时均匀混合图外，这些都是参数集及其补集的两个无限族的成员，对于它们，我们给出了具有两个观察时间的显式定律。

Petersen 图及其补图是最小的成员。具有 UAM 的强正则图在没有瞬时均匀混合时准确地承认有界时间密度。我们还纠正了 Godsil、Mullin 和 Roy 对强正则图上瞬时均匀混合的分类。它的符号条件不包括减半的 $5$ 立方体，它在时间 $\pi/4$ 均匀混合。从字面上看，顺序 $4\theta^2$ 的奇偶校验条件也排除了 Clebsch 图，并包含参数 $(36,14,4,6)$，对于这些参数，没有时间定律给出均匀的平均混合。

title: Can we make sense out of negative kinetic energy?
abstract: Many Quantum Field Theory models, either designed to improve the ultraviolet behavior via higher derivative terms or aimed at providing unified descriptions of Gravity, inevitably introduce negative-energy 'ghosts' states. These states raise fundamental questions regarding the stability of the theory. In this study, we investigate the time evolution of simplified quantum mechanical models consisting of two coupled normal and ghost subsystems. Although the full spectrum of these models is unbounded from below and, therefore, lacks a true ground state, we focus the time evolution of a 'would-be ground state': a zero-energy eigenstate of the decoupled system. By analyzing its metastability under interactions, we gain insights into the dynamics of ghost-like states. Contrary to the standard paradigm, our results demonstrate that, across a broad range of couplings, the would-be ground state does not decay and remains dynamically stable over long times. This provides evidence towards resolving the stability problems of Hamiltonians that are unbounded from below. We also discuss the connections with the corresponding classical and semiclassical dynamics.
summary: 许多量子场论模型，无论是旨在通过更高的导数项改善紫外线行为，还是旨在提供重力的统一描述，都不可避免地引入负能量“幽灵”态。这些状态提出了有关理论稳定性的基本问题。在这项研究中，我们研究了由两个耦合的正常子系统和幽灵子系统组成的简化量子力学模型的时间演化。尽管这些模型的全谱从下方无界，因此缺乏真正的基态，但我们关注“可能的基态”的时间演化：解耦系统的零能量本征态。通过分析其在相互作用下的亚稳态，我们深入了解类鬼态的动力学。与标准范式相反，我们的结果表明，在广泛的耦合范围内，潜在的基态不会衰减，并且在很长一段时间内保持动态稳定。这为解决自下而上无界的哈密顿量的稳定性问题提供了证据。我们还讨论了与相应的经典和半经典动力学的联系。

title: Tradeoff between Wigner negativity and decoherence time for cubic Gaussian states
abstract: Wigner negativity has been shown to be a resource in quantum computing, raising the question of how to efficiently produce states with a large Wigner negativity. Cubic Gaussian states, obtained when a cubic gate is applied to a Gaussian state, have been proposed as candidates for this purpose. We show that cubic Gaussian states with a large Wigner negativity $\mathcal N$ necessarily have a short decoherence time $\tau$ that is bounded above by $\mathcal N^{-2}$. In other words, a large Wigner negativity comes at a cost: the decoherence time $\tau$ of cubic Gaussian states decreases at least quadratically in the negativity $\mathcal N$. Maximizing $\tau$ at fixed Wigner negativity $\mathcal N$, we show that this upper bound is reached by optimal cubic Gaussian states. They have the property that for large negativity, the optimal squeezing scales as $\ln\mathcal N$ and the optimal cubicity as $\mathcal N^{-1}$. Optimal cubic Gaussian states with large negativity can therefore be constructed with small cubicity, provided sufficient squeezing is applied. However, their decoherence time decreases with growing negativity. In addition, we show that their preparation is extremely sensitive to thermal noise. Finally, we compare, for each integer $n$, the optimal cubic Gaussian state with the $n$th Fock state that has the same negativity: despite their pronounced differences in photon number distribution and Wigner function, we show that they have similar, be it slightly larger, decoherence times and entanglement generating potential through a beam splitter.
summary:
维格纳负性已被证明是量子计算中的一种资源，这就提出了如何有效地产生具有大维格纳负性的状态的问题。当立方门应用于高斯状态时获得的立方高斯状态已被提议作为此目的的候选状态。我们证明，具有大维格纳负性 $\mathcal N$ 的三次高斯态必然具有较短的退相干时间 $\tau$，其上界为 $\mathcal N^{-2}$。换句话说，大的维格纳负性是有代价的：三次高斯态的退相干时间 $\tau$ 在负性 $\mathcal N$ 中至少呈二次方减少。在固定维格纳负性 $\mathcal N$ 处最大化 $\tau$，我们表明最优三次高斯态可以达到这个上限。它们具有以下性质：对于较大的负值，最佳压缩尺度为 $\ln\mathcal N$，最佳立方度为 $\mathcal N^{-1}$。因此，只要施加足够的压缩，就可以用小立方度构造具有大负性的最佳立方高斯态。然而，它们的退相干时间随着负性的增加而减少。

此外，我们还表明它们的制备对热噪声极其敏感。最后，对于每个整数 $n$，我们将最佳立方高斯态与具有相同负性的第 $n$ 个 Fock 态进行比较：尽管它们在光子数分布和维格纳函数方面存在显着差异，但我们表明它们具有相似的退相干时间和通过分束器产生纠缠的潜力，只是稍大一些。

title: Characterizing Fermionic Non-Gaussianity in the Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev Model via Replica Twist Entropy
abstract: Understanding the non-equilibrium dynamics of quantum many-body systems plays a central role in modern many-body physics. Intriguing insights emerge from investigating how quantum resources, which are essential for achieving unambiguous quantumness, are generated and spread under chaotic quantum dynamics. In fermionic systems, non-Gaussianity constitutes an important resource beyond entanglement, characterizing the deviation of generic quantum states from free-fermion states. In this Letter, we propose using the \textit{replica twist entropy}, defined through the expectation value of a replica rotation operator with a tunable angle $\alpha$, as a natural probe of non-Gaussianity in pure fermionic states. After deriving its behavior for typical many-body states, we establish a general framework for analyzing the replica twist entropy in solvable Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev models in the large-$N$ limit. Applying this framework to the dynamics of the thermofield double state, we uncover a novel dynamical phase diagram in the parameter space of $\alpha$ and evolution time $t$, exhibiting spontaneous $Z_2$ symmetry breaking at $\alpha=\pi/4$ and universal cusps as a function of $\alpha$ in the long-time regime. Our results pave the way for studying non-Gaussianity in strongly correlated fermionic systems and reveal a new class of dynamical transitions probed by non-Gaussianity.
summary:
了解量子多体系统的非平衡动力学在现代多体物理学中发挥着核心作用。通过研究量子资源（对于实现明确的量子性至关重要）如何在混沌量子动力学下生成和传播，得出了有趣的见解。在费米子系统中，非高斯性构成了纠缠之外的重要资源，表征了一般量子态与自由费米子态的偏差。在这封信中，我们建议使用 \textit{副本扭曲熵}（通过具有可调角度 $\alpha$ 的副本旋转算子的期望值定义）作为纯费米态中非高斯性的自然探针。在推导出典型多体状态的行为后，我们建立了一个通用框架，用于分析可解 Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev 模型中大 $N$ 限制下的副本扭曲熵。

将该框架应用于热场双态动力学，我们在 $\alpha$ 和演化时间 $t$ 的参数空间中发现了一种新颖的动力学相图，展示了 $\alpha=\pi/4$ 处的自发 $Z_2$ 对称性破缺，以及在长期状态下作为 $\alpha$ 函数的通用尖点。我们的结果为研究强相关费米子系统中的非高斯性铺平了道路，并揭示了非高斯性探测的一类新的动态转变。

title: Inequivalent Quantum Resources from Multipartite State Discrimination
abstract: Any two orthogonal quantum states can be perfectly distinguished via local operations and classical communication (LOCC), yet whether all orthogonal multipartite pairs incur an identical operational cost remains an open question. Here, we address the resource consumption required for local state discrimination across multipartite pair of states. We demonstrate that distinct pairs of orthogonal multipartite maximally entangled states require unequal amounts of quantum resources to achieve local distinguishability. Extending our framework beyond individual pairs, we analyze larger sets of both locally distinguishable and indistinguishable multipartite orthogonal states, revealing a nontrivial hierarchy in their entanglement consumption. These results show that the resource cost of LOCC discrimination is state-dependent, providing insight into the fine-grained structure of multipartite nonlocality.
summary: 任何两个正交量子态都可以通过局部操作和经典通信（LOCC）完美区分，但所有正交多部分对是否会产生相同的操作成本仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。在这里，我们解决了跨多方国家对的地方国家歧视所需的资源消耗。我们证明，不同的正交多部分最大纠缠态对需要不等量的量子资源才能实现局部可区分性。将我们的框架扩展到单个对之外，我们分析了更大的局部可区分和不可区分的多部分正交状态集，揭示了它们的纠缠消耗中的非平凡层次结构。这些结果表明，LOCC 歧视的资源成本是依赖于状态的，提供了对多部分非局域性的细粒度结构的深入了解。

title: Dynamics of Work Extraction in Multipartite Atomic Systems: Role of Correlations and Relative Entropy
abstract: We investigate the dynamics of quantum ergotropy in a multipartite system of two-level atoms interacting with a quantized field. The role of multipartite quantum mutual information and quantum relative entropy is analyzed to understand how correlations and the distinguishability between the passive state and the product of local states affect the extractable work. Numerical results for systems containing two to five atoms show that the maximum ergotropy does not increase linearly with the system size, while the intervals of zero ergotropy are gradually modified and suppressed for larger systems. We also study the effect of the average thermal photon number and different initial atomic states. Increasing the thermal photon number mainly reduces the relative-entropy contribution, whereas the initial state strongly influences both the magnitude and persistence of ergotropy. Among the considered states, the partially entangled state provides the largest and more persistent extractable work, while the mixed GHZ state gives the smallest ergotropy. These results highlight the importance of multipartite correlations, thermal effects, and state preparation in controlling quantum work extraction and may be useful for future studies of quantum batteries and quantum power.
summary:
我们研究了两能级原子与量子场相互作用的多部分系统中量子各向异性的动力学。分析多部分量子互信息和量子相对熵的作用，以了解被动态与局域态乘积之间的相关性和可区分性如何影响可提取功。包含两到五个原子的系统的数值结果表明，最大各向异性并不随着系统尺寸线性增加，而对于较大的系统，零各向异性​​的间隔逐渐被修改和抑制。我们还研究了平均热光子数和不同初始原子态的影响。增加热光子数主要减少相对熵的贡献，而初始状态强烈影响各向异性的大小和持久性。在所考虑的状态中，部分纠缠态提供最大且更持久的可提取功，而混合 GHZ 状态则提供最小的各向异性。

这些结果强调了多部分相关性、热效应和状态准备在控制量子功提取中的重要性，并且可能对量子电池和量子电力的未来研究有用。

title: An Explicit Counterexample to Tsirelson's Problem via a Linear System Game
abstract: We construct an explicit binary linear system game that separates \(C_{qa}\), the closure of the set of finite dimensional quantum correlations, from \(C_{qc}\), the set of commuting operator correlations. The game admits a perfect commuting operator strategy, while every correlation in \(C_{qa}\) has a success probability strictly less than 1. This provides a concrete counterexample to Tsirelson's problem in its approximation form. The defining system has \(1{,}417{,}152\) equations in \(1{,}889{,}684\) variables, with exactly three nonzero coefficients per equation and a single nonzero entry on the right hand side. We also compute the classical value exactly. The complete system is specified in Lean~4, and the separation and exact classical value are formalized using Mathlib.
summary: 我们构建了一个显式二元线性系统博弈，将有限维量子相关性集合的闭包 C_{qa} 与通勤算子相关性集合 C_{qc} 分开。该博弈承认完美的通勤算子策略，而 \(C_{qa}\) 中的每个相关性的成功概率严格小于 1。这为 Tsirelson 问题的近似形式提供了具体的反例。定义系统在 \(1{,}889{,}684\) 变量中具有 \(1{,}417{,}152\) 个方程，每个方程恰好有三个非零系数，右侧有一个非零条目。我们还精确计算经典值。完整的系统在 Lean~4 中指定，并且使用 Mathlib 形式化了分离和精确的经典值。

title: Numerically exact simulation of open quantum networks with strong system-bath couplings using tensor network path integrals
abstract: Non-Markovian open quantum networks are among the most challenging problems in quantum theory, as they suffer from both, the exponentially scaling many-body state space as well as long memory times when the sites are strongly coupled to structured environments. Recent efforts to address them by combining tensor networks with real-time path integrals, such as TEMPO and process tensors, were however limited to systems with rather weak system-environment couplings because strong couplings lead to large bond dimensions. Here, we devise a tensor network scheme (CTEMPO) resulting in particularly small bond dimensions for single-site problems. We then extend this to a practical scheme to simulate non-Markovian quantum networks by time-evolving a corresponding comb tensor network. Benchmarking the single-site algorithm on the spin-boson model we find orders-of-magnitude improvement over established methods. The multi-site algorithm is shown to solve the notoriously difficult problem of the 7-site Fenna-Matthews-Olson photosynthetic complex, whose spectral density contains 62 peaks. We then apply our approach to explore the scaling behavior of the superradiance of up to $N=20$ quantum dots individually coupled to super-Ohmic phonon baths. Our approach provides a turnkey solution to non-Markovian quantum networks and is compatible with more general tensor network topologies.
summary:
非马尔可夫开放量子网络是量子理论中最具挑战性的问题之一，因为它们同时受到指数缩放的多体状态空间以及当站点与结构化环境强耦合时的长存储时间的影响。然而，最近通过将张量网络与实时路径积分（例如 TEMPO 和过程张量）相结合来解决这些问题的努力仅限于系统-环境耦合相当弱的系统，因为强耦合会导致大的键维数。在这里，我们设计了一种张量网络方案（CTEMPO），为单点问题带来特别小的键维。然后，我们将其扩展到一个实用方案，通过时间演化相应的梳张量网络来模拟非马尔可夫量子网络。对自旋玻色子模型上的单点算法进行基准测试，我们发现比现有方法有数量级的改进。多站点算法被证明可以解决 7 站点 Fenna-Matthews-Olson 光合复合体的众所周知的难题，该复合体的光谱密度包含 62 个峰值。

然后，我们应用我们的方法来探索高达 $N=20$ 量子点的超辐射的缩放行为，这些量子点单独耦合到超欧姆声子浴。我们的方法为非马尔可夫量子网络提供了交钥匙解决方案，并且与更通用的张量网络拓扑兼容。

title: Dynamically protected erasure qubit via low-frequency charge driving
abstract: Dynamical protection via strong driving can enable resilient quantum processing on imperfect physical hardware. However, the practical utility of such schemes is frequently limited by parasitic processes such as drive-induced dephasing and leakage. Here, we demonstrate that sub-GHz charge driving of superconducting Kerr oscillators (KOs) in the transmon regime circumvents this trade-off, simultaneously activating fast parametric interactions and protecting the encoded qubit from low-frequency noise. The key is the frequency dependence of the charge sensitivity: using the AC Stark shift as a probe, we find that the KO frequency sensitivity to a charge drive grows quadratically with both drive frequency and amplitude, making the oscillator weakly sensitive to $1/f$ charge noise yet strongly coupled to drives near 1~GHz. Exploiting this, we first demonstrate cooling and reset of the KO in 82~ns, to a residual population below $0.7\%$---lower than its $2.5\%$ steady-state thermal population. Next, using two KOs, we demonstrate logical control and dynamical protection of a dual-rail qubit with nearly fourfold erasure bias. Finally, using a single end-of-circuit erasure check, we achieve an error per Clifford of $5.6\times10^{-4}$, which falls to $1.5\times10^{-4}$ after post-selection, with 25~ns gates.
summary:
通过强驱动的动态保护可以在不完善的物理硬件上实现弹性量子处理。然而，此类方案的实际应用经常受到驱动引起的移相和泄漏等寄生过程的限制。在这里，我们证明了超导克尔振荡器（KO）在传输机制中的 sub-GHz 电荷驱动规避了这种权衡，同时激活快速参数相互作用并保护编码的量子位免受低频噪声的影响。关键是电荷灵敏度的频率依赖性：使用 AC Stark 频移作为探针，我们发现电荷驱动的 KO 频率灵敏度随驱动频率和幅度呈二次方增长，使得振荡器对 $1/f$ 电荷噪声较弱敏感，但与 1~GHz 附近的驱动强烈耦合。利用这一点，我们首先证明了 KO 在 82~ns 内冷却和重置，剩余种群低于 $0.7\%$——低于其 $2.5\%$ 稳态热种群。接下来，使用两个 KO，我们演示了具有近四倍擦除偏差的双轨量子位的逻辑控制和动态保护。

最后，使用单个电路末端擦除检查，我们实现了每个 Clifford 的错误 $5.6\times10^{-4}$，在后选择后，使用 25~ns 门，该错误降至 $1.5\times10^{-4}$。

title: Efficient Estimation of Logical Sensitivities Through Fault-Counting
abstract:
Quantum error-correcting circuits are affected by multiple physical noise mechanisms, whose contributions to logical failure must be understood to evaluate code performance and guide improvements in hardware. The individual error budget contributions for an error type $i$ can be characterized by its logical sensitivity $
u_i =  rac{\partial p_L}{\partial p_i}$, which measures the response of the logical error rate $p_L$ to each physical noise parameter $p_i$. Normally, $
u_i$ is measured using linear fits such as finite differences, where $p_L$ is measured at two or more values of $p_i$ to calculate partial derivatives. In this paper, we develop a differentiable estimator to obtain all components of $
abla_{\mathbf p}p_L$ simultaneously from a single Monte Carlo data set at one noise configuration, using information about the underlying fault configurations. In surface code simulations with circuit-level noise, the estimator agrees with conventional finite differences while requiring one to two orders of magnitude fewer shots to achieve the same variance. We apply this technique to quantify error budgets, resolve sensitivities at the individual qubit level, and infer effective code distance. Finally, we incorporate the sensitivities into Newton root finding to locate and trace threshold contours in multidimensional noise models. These results provide an efficient method for extracting and applying logical sensitivity information from standard quantum error correction simulations.
summary:
量子纠错电路受到多种物理噪声机制的影响，必须了解它们对逻辑故障的贡献，以评估代码性能并指导硬件改进。错误类型 $i$ 的各个错误预算贡献可以通过其逻辑灵敏度 $
u_i =  rac{\partial p_L}{\partial p_i}$ 来表征，它测量逻辑错误率 $p_L$ 对每个物理噪声参数 $p_i$ 的响应。通常，$
u_i$ 使用线性拟合（例如有限差分）来测量，其中 $p_L$ 在两个或多个 $p_i$ 值处测量，以计算偏导数。在本文中，我们开发了一种可微估计器，使用有关底层故障配置的信息，从一个噪声配置的单个蒙特卡罗数据集中同时获取 $
abla_{\mathbf p}p_L$ 的所有分量。在具有电路级噪声的表面代码仿真中，估计器与传统的有限差分一致，同时需要减少一到两个数量级的镜头才能实现相同的方差。

我们应用这种技术来量化错误预算，解决单个量子位级别的敏感性，并推断有效代码距离。最后，我们将灵敏度合并到牛顿求根中，以在多维噪声模型中定位和跟踪阈值轮廓。这些结果提供了一种从标准量子纠错模拟中提取和应用逻辑灵敏度信息的有效方法。
